raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 21  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner erroneously concluded that Maria of Aragon was identified as Portuguese due to her title "Queen of Portugal," despite being recognized historically as Spanish because of her parentage (Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon). This reflects an error in interpreting nationality based on title rather than birth origin. The Planner should have utilized the available information regarding her parents and the region associated with them (Spain), rather than interpreting her nationality solely based on her marriage and title in Portugal.
